The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c417858c9fe566da), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 13. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Let E/Q have conductor N, and let S be a finite set of primes containing the prime divisors of 2N. Prescribe a real sign σ ∈ {1, −1} and a unit squareclass cp ∈ Z× p /Z×2 p for each p ∈ S. Suppose that these data are realized by an odd fundamental discriminant, and that twists in this filter have root number ε. For every finite set B of primes there are odd fundamental discriminants D of arbitrarily large absolute value such that sign(D) = σ, [D]p = cp (p ∈ S), p ∤ D (p ∈ B), Moreover: (i) If ε = 1, they can be chosen with L(E(D), 1) ̸= 0 and ω(|D|) ≤ 5. (ii) If ε = −1, they can be chosen with L′(E(D), 1) ̸= 0, so the central zero is simple. The bound five in (i) is independent of E, S, B and the prescribed classes. In either case, every prime factor of D can be required to exceed any previously fixed bound.
